title: The Tune at the Gate  (门口的曲调)

segments.t: 汉娜和阿瑟、伊芙琳一起匆匆赶到敞开的庭院大门前，热情地招呼那位站在街上倾听的老邻居。先完整听一遍吧。
Excuse me, sir, would you like to come inside for a warm cup of tea?
Wait... our neighbor from the violin shop at number ten?!
You know each other, Arthur?!
Thirty years ago, he brought his violin here every Friday at six!
Wait, look at our old postcard: 'Save two chairs for the baker and the teacher'!
He was the music teacher who played Friday duets with your aunt!
He just asked me who finally finished the second half of her May waltz!
What did he say when he heard my sixteen bars through the window, Arthur?
He had tears in his eyes. He said it sounded just like her voice!
Did you invite him to our grand opening this Friday at six o'clock?!
He promised to bring his violin, and ten neighbors from down the street!
Ten extra neighbors?! Tessa is going to need twice as many lemons by Friday!
现在，让我们一句一句来回味这段充满惊喜的重逢。
Excuse me, sir, would you like to come inside for a warm cup of tea?
「打扰一下，先生，您想进来喝杯热茶吗？」 比起简单的 do you want，这个条件句
would you like
要礼貌热情得多，是邀请邻居进门的最理想表达。
Wait... our neighbor from the violin shop at number ten?!
「等等……我们十号小提琴店的邻居？！」 在街上的一栋建筑或门牌号前面，英语使用表示特定地点的介词
at number ten
指明人行道上的那个确切位置。
You know each other, Arthur?!
「你们认识彼此，阿瑟？！」 我们中文里说“互相认识”，英语里表达这种相互关系用的是
know each other
字面意思就是“认识一个和另一个”。
Thirty years ago, he brought his violin here every Friday at six!
「三十年前，他每个星期五六点都带着他的小提琴来这里！」 动词 bring 的不规则过去式。注意乐器名词前的物主代词：
he brought his violin
在英语里说到随身携带的乐器时，通常会加上 his 或 her。
Wait, look at our old postcard: 'Save two chairs for the baker and the teacher'!
「等等，看看我们那张旧明信片：“给面包师和老师留两把椅子”！」 把某样东西保留下来，或者不让别人占用，
Save two chairs
这个动词常用于在咖啡馆或剧院里“占座”。
He was the music teacher who played Friday duets with your aunt!
「他就是那位和你阿姨在星期五合奏的音乐老师！」 在英语里，两位音乐家一起演奏乐曲叫作
Friday duets
既可以指这首双人演奏的曲子，也可以指这种表演形式。
He just asked me who finally finished the second half of her May waltz!
「他刚才问我，是谁最终完成了她的五月华尔兹的下半部分！」 在提到创作于某个月份的作品时，月份的名字常常直接作为修饰语：
her May waltz
把 May 放在 waltz 前面，就成了“五月华尔兹”。
What did he say when he heard my sixteen bars through the window, Arthur?
「阿瑟，他隔着窗户听到我弹的十六小节时说了什么？」 介词 through 表示穿过一个空间或开口，
through the window
形象地描绘了音乐从窗户里面飘到外面街上的过程。
He had tears in his eyes. He said it sounded just like her voice!
「他眼里含着泪水。他说听起来就像她的声音一样！」 这是一个非常动人的比喻，用来形容音乐的感染力，
sounded just like her voice
表示那琴声就如同故人亲自在说话、在歌唱。
Did you invite him to our grand opening this Friday at six o'clock?!
「你邀请他参加我们这周五六点钟的盛大开业了吗？！」 在英语里，商店、餐厅或客栈正式开始营业的第一天被称为
grand opening
这是一个充满期待和仪式感的时刻。
He promised to bring his violin, and ten neighbors from down the street!
「他答应带着他的小提琴，以及街那头的十个邻居一起来！」 用来指代住在同一条街上，但有一段距离的邻居们，
from down the street
意思是顺着这条街走过去的那几户人家。
Ten extra neighbors?! Tessa is going to need twice as many lemons by Friday!
「额外十个邻居？！到周五泰莎需要的柠檬得是现在的两倍了！」 英语里表达“两倍多”的经典结构，
twice as many lemons
放在可数名词前面，说明用量要翻倍了！准备好迎接热闹的大结局吧。
Excuse me, sir, would you like to come inside for a warm cup of tea?
Wait... our neighbor from the violin shop at number ten?!
You know each other, Arthur?!
Thirty years ago, he brought his violin here every Friday at six!
Wait, look at our old postcard: 'Save two chairs for the baker and the teacher'!
He was the music teacher who played Friday duets with your aunt!
He just asked me who finally finished the second half of her May waltz!
What did he say when he heard my sixteen bars through the window, Arthur?
He had tears in his eyes. He said it sounded just like her voice!
Did you invite him to our grand opening this Friday at six o'clock?!
He promised to bring his violin, and ten neighbors from down the street!
Ten extra neighbors?! Tessa is going to need twice as many lemons by Friday!
那位三十年前星期五二重奏的搭档听到了敞开的窗户里传出的琴声，这周五六点，他不仅要带着他的小提琴来，还要带半条街的人来！第五集到这里就结束了——我们第二季大结局见！
Have a great evening!
